units.source_text: 我儘量不弄出聲音，悄悄地倒滿一杯水，

en.t: I tried not to make any sound and quietly filled a glass with water,

units.source_text: 然後慢慢撕開紙盒，把全部藥粒放入口中，

en.t: then slowly tore open the paper box and put all the pills into my mouth,

units.source_text: 冷靜地喝完杯子裡的水，就那麼關燈睡覺了。

en.t: calmly drank all the water in the glass, turned off the light, and went to sleep just like that.

units.source_text: 據說整整三天三夜，我睡得像死了一樣。

en.t: They say I slept like the dead for three whole days and nights.

units.source_text: 醫生認為是過失所致，猶豫著一直沒有報警。

en.t: The doctor thought it had been an accident and hesitated, never reporting it to the police.

units.source_text: 還說我醒來說的第一句話是「我要回家」，

en.t: They also said the first words I spoke when I woke were, "I want to go home,"

units.source_text: 我所說的「家」，究竟是指的哪裡呢？

en.t: but where exactly was the "home" I meant?

units.source_text: 總之，據說我說完這句話後，大哭了一場。

en.t: In any case, they say that after saying those words, I cried bitterly.

units.source_text: 眼前的霧漸漸散去，我定睛一看，

en.t: The mist before my eyes gradually cleared, and when I looked closely,

units.source_text: 比目魚板著臉，一副極其不悅的神情，坐在我的枕頭邊。

en.t: Hirame was sitting by my pillow with a stern face and an extremely displeased expression.
